note: What each Coolify app must have. The systems check reads the apps through the Coolify API (console's COOLIFY_URL + COOLIFY_TOKEN) and Auto fix sets what's wrong through deploy/coolify-fix.py on the VPS, approved on axHub. Override this file with .axf-console/plugins/systems-check/coolify-expect.json. Rules: equals (exact), includes (every listed item is in the list value; sep picks ',' or ' '), sameAs (equals a secret the VPS holds; never shown).

env.why: the hub's sign-in works across every amberxai.com app
the console and Build Pilot read the look and settings from the hub (appearance@1)
the console's axHub tab shows the app catalog
signed-in hub users reach the console (it must match the console's wall secret)
